title: Spicy Korean Roast Chicken Jjigae
description: A fusion of Indian spices and Korean flavors, this spicy roast chicken jjigae is a hearty and comforting meal. Serve with naan or rice for a complete experience.

ingredients.name: roast chicken
ingredients.notes: boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the curry powder and korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the roast chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the jjigae sauce and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve with basmati rice and garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
